kind: CPU-only perturbative theory diagnostic, not a material or trajectory qualification

model.hamiltonian: H=sum_i E_i c_i^dagger c_i + Omega b^dagger b + g (c^dagger M c)(b+b^dagger)
model.vertex: M_02=M_12=M_20=M_21=1, all other entries zero; complex phase also tested
model.phase_convention: The fixed E is the zeroth-order free Hamiltonian. Consistent O(g^2) Hs shifts affect these second-order rates at O(g^4); this is not a finite-g self-consistent material closure.

identities.definitions: Delta_i=E_2+Omega-E_i=(3,2.5); beta_i=g M_i2/Delta_i; B=beta beta^dagger; U=exp(-i E_PP t)
identities.finite_memory_quench: h_PP=alpha alpha^dagger+O(g^4), alpha_i=beta_i(1-exp(+i Delta_i t)); rho_22=Tr(h_PP)+O(g^4)
identities.bare_Markov_source: Gamma_p,PP=i[E_PP,B]; C_PP(P)=-i[E_PP,B], which is trace zero but indefinite
identities.correlated_ground_state: h_GS=B+O(g^4); free commutator and Markov PV source cancel to O(g^2)
identities.slipped_start_identity: For h_PP(0)=2B, the second-order Markov solution is B+U B U^dagger, positive; this equals the quench expression after discarding fast exp(+/-i Delta_i t) cross terms, not an exact long-time average of the undamped oscillator

checks.ED_quench_error_GS_dressing_error_GS_rhs: g^4: factors between 15.7 and 16.3 on halving g

finite_eta_tail_diagnostic.definition: Leading g^2 RHS at rho_GS^(2): free commutator on the dressed density plus collision at P; no g^4 feedback included
finite_eta_tail_diagnostic.interpretation: Finite eta gives off-resonant Lorentzian population tails and O(g^2 eta) stationarity error at small eta. A finite-width bath requires its own consistent preparation/statistics; the undamped GS cancellation is not its stationarity proof.

scope_limits: Exact positivity of the joint model does not prove general positivity of finite-memory approximate GKBA.
The isolated oscillator has persistent memory; no universal Markov/slippage theorem is asserted.
A bare projector is a valid factorized interaction quench, but then its finite lower time endpoint must be respected; inserting infinite history does not describe that same preparation.
A correlated initial density alone generally does not specify initial correlations. A consistent IC integral or history is needed in a finite-memory NEGF calculation.
The runtime density is an equal-time one-particle density in a rotated orbital basis. Relabelling it as a bare quasiparticle distribution does not derive the missing off-shell density map.
A Hermitian counterterm cannot change P[H,P]P or Q[H,P]Q and cannot repair the fixed projector boundary compression.
A true correlated ground-state preparation can remove the leading artifact in this controlled example; an arbitrary stationary Markov solution is not a variational ground state.
No production code, material density, saved W, collision law, numerical guard, or clipping was changed. No SSH/GPU work.

primary_sources.use: Karlsson et al. 2018: negative-time IC integral, equilibrium stationarity, prescribed-equilibrium-W IC in Appendix C; Section V warns stationarity is not a variational ground-state equation.
Gaspard and Nagaoka 1999: weak-coupling Redfield initial slippage represents short-time non-Markov bath relaxation; example positivity restoration, not a universal guarantee.
Spicka and Lipavsky 1995: observables require corrections beyond quasiparticle approximation, rather than identifying the distribution with all physical observables.
Morawetz 2023 Eq.13 explicitly relates physical reduced density and quasiparticle distribution through an off-shell correlation term.
